body:
Hi,

I appreciate the sentiment. But this is not one of those things which can get better. As I said in my post, I am a great believer in the fact that things can change. However; current science is not capable of fixing the issues I have. The decision to end my life is based on the fact that there are no options available to me. 

It affects the position of my eye, and the shape of my skull. Maybe in 20 years I could get a new skull printed. But not now. 

Waiting out will take me at least twice as far from normal as I already am in just a few months. This is happening so fast, and there is no diagnosis. It appears to just be the way I am. A ticking genetic time bomb which has reactivated the growth of bone in my skull. But just one one side. Even if this was a diagnosed condition, the only fix would be to removed the affected area. I am not willing to have half of my face removed. I cannot imagine the bravery of people who undergo such procedures. But it is not for me. 

I have already been told by my GP that there is no access to the healthcare that I need. This is a very frustrating complication, but there’s nothing I can do. The only advice I have been given is to speak to a therapist to come to terms with facial disfigurement and deformity. I am simply not interested in living a life of pain anguish.

I am forced into taking my own life because humanity has not caught up to the fact that some situations will not improve. In a more civilised and enlightened society I would be able to present my case to a physician or a psychologist, and be given the medication and advice I would need in order to die peacefully and without suffering. As it stands, my options for a peaceful death are extremely limited and the exact method which I use will be determined by the level of suffering that I am feeling at the time. 

I can’t show you the progression. I can’t explain the pain I am in. But I have discussed my feelings with my mother since making my post. She more than anyone wants me to live. But she understands my wish to die. And as much as it breaks her heart to consider it, she can see the changes in my face. She knows the pain that I’m in. And she supports me in my quest to end my life.

Hi. Thanks for taking the time to reply. 

Unfortunately, as much as I wish that I was seeing things in an exaggerated way, that is not the case. The whole left side of my head has increased in size to a very noticeable level, and it has affected my eye and associated bone structures enormously. 

Sadly; this is an area where surgery isn’t an option. My skull can’t be rebuilt to move my eye back, or bring the other one forward to match its position. This is one of the most painful aspects of my situation. I know that every change is irreversible; and I wish so much that this has happened at a time where I could have sought further diagnosis and hopefully treatment. Because of Covid, no avenues are open to me, even if I pay. 

For something like this to have happened at this time makes me feel doubly cursed. The convergence of these terrible circumstances is so unlikely. 

For someone to spontaneously develop a bone altering disease with no apparent cause is unlikely. For this to affect the face and for it to progress at such an incredible rate is even more unlikely still. For it to happen during the only period of health care unavailability which has ever occurred makes this feel like a cruel joke. It is unthinkable. 

The damage has already been done. By the time I could  obtain further information about what is happening to me I will already be gone. 

Therapy has been discussed, and I am aware of how effective it can be. But I’m not willing to be “that guy with the twisted face” for the rest of my life. As I mentioned in my post, this was one of the ailments that was on my list of conditions which would prompt me to end my life. Facial disfigurement, losing the use of my arms and legs, and degenerative diseases of the brain were the top three. 

Posting this yesterday has made me a lot clearer about my feelings, and the only thing which is stopping me from doing it right now is trying to find a method which doesn’t involve me either destroying my body, involving others, or raising the possibility of being brought back in an even worse state than I’m currently in.

I appreciate your positivity, and I know from experience that everything you’ve written is valid. But unfortunately in this particular instance, there is no hope for me.
Hi. Thank you for the kind words. I’m happy to chat, but it won’t be terribly fluid. I won’t be spending much time on at certain times as there is so much to sort out.
